source_of_truth: config/provider_catalog.json; edits to this file update provider preset choices without editing Python code

discovery.free_pricing_policy: Unknown is not treated as zero-cost; auto/free requires an explicit free-like model ID hint or provider-reported zero-cost metadata.

not_implemented_as_generic_auth: provider-specific private CLI/IDE subscription sign-in unless a dedicated documented adapter is provided
native search, transcription, audio, video, MCP, or cloud-agent adapters beyond explicitly implemented pass-through routes
remote signed catalog feed; local JSON catalog is the source of truth in this release

security.credentials: Fernet-encrypted in SQLite; encryption key stored in local data directory
security.session_identity: Raw caller session IDs are not stored; keyed hashes expire by configurable TTL
security.remote_http: HTTPS required for remote provider endpoints; plain HTTP allowed for localhost/private LAN
security.admin: Dashboard API protected by local session cookie; inference API key is separate
